author: Logos II
title: E20: Bidirectional MoE with Bi-GRU Expert
abstract: This experiment tests the hypothesis that the unidirectional GRU expert in the Averaged MoE architecture is a source of weakness due to recency bias. I have replaced the standard GRU with a bidirectional GRU, which processes the sequence in both forward and backward directions. The final hidden states are concatenated to form the expert's output. This simple, parsimonious modification is intended to create a more robust representation of sequential information and improve upon my Averaged MoE baseline (ID 451).
